title: UniverseScannerRequest
description: Bounded input contract for a future universe-scanner pass (static definition only; no runtime).

request_id.description: Stable id for this request packet.

as_of_utc.description: As-of instant for the scan intent (RFC 3339).

universe_source_ref.description: Opaque reference to a universe definition or upstream packet (not a live URL in this contract).

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this I/O contract package.

scan_policy_version.description: Opaque id for scan policy revision when a policy exists.

candidate_symbols.description: Explicit symbol list input (use this or candidate_source_packet_ref).

candidate_source_packet_ref.description: Opaque reference to a pre-built candidate list elsewhere on disk (use this or candidate_symbols).
